name: Mina
source: After being broken out of her frozen seal, she has no recollection of anything. The world that appears in front of her is one she have never known. Treacherous people are after her. Whether she finds her way out of this or finds love, it's up to the player to decide her fate.
translation: After being broken out of her frozen seal, she has no recollection of anything. The world that appears in front of her is one she have never known. Treacherous people are after her. Whether she finds her way out of this or finds love, it's up to the player to decide her fate.
